content.Title: TABLE 33 Evidence Gaps and Future Research Directions

Points: Consensus on specific classifications of HFpEF, HFrEF, HFmrEF, and HFimpEF.
Definitions, detection, and management of myocarditis and myocardial injury.
Definition and classification of cardiomyopathies.
Cost-effectiveness of screening strategies for HF.
Prediction of higher risk for HF among patients with traditional risk factors.
Individualized treatment targeting specific causes.
Precision medicine incorporating genetic and personalized factors.
High-value methods using biomarkers in therapy optimization.
Integrated systems biology models for diagnosis and prognosis.
Monitoring and adjusting therapy over time.
Efficacy of dietary interventions, sodium restriction, and fluid restriction.
Efficacy and safety of rehabilitation in HFpEF and HFmrEF.
Effective management for patients with HFpEF.
Specific treatment strategies for HFmrEF.
Research on therapies for cardiomyopathies like peripartum cardiomyopathy.
Treatment of asymptomatic LV dysfunction.
Therapies targeting different phenotypes of HF.
Studies on decongestion, cardiorenal syndrome, and diuretic resistance.
Strategies for RV failure.
Efficacy and safety of hydralazine isosorbide and ARNi.
Efficacy and safety of vericiguat and omecamtiv mecarbil.
Efficacy and safety of SGLT2i therapies.
Efficacy and safety of nonsteroidal, selective MRA.
Effective management strategies for combined post- and precapillary pulmonary hypertension.
Novel treatments for ATTR cardiomyopathy.
Strategies for fibrosis, cardiac metabolism, and contractile performance.
Comparative strategies for GDMT titration.
Patient preference prediction studies.
